title: Every other purchase in the game explicitly names and deducts a gold cost (e.g. 'buy a quench-flask — 3 gold'), but asking Factor Corrin for 'cinder-oil, for the chapel' hands over a full cask with no price shown or charged, breaking the game's own established shop pattern.
where: The Ironbound Scale-House (Emberfall) / talk to Factor Corrin, 'cinder-oil, for the chapel'

evidence.quote: Every other purchase in the game explicitly names and deducts a gold cost (e.g. 'buy a quench-flask — 3 gold'), but asking Factor Corrin for 'cinder-oil, for the chapel' hands over a full cask with no price shown or charged, breaking the game's own established shop pattern.
